authorship: Our synthesis; card rules checked against fra_preview.json. Source tips are attributed separately. No empirical tier or averaged score.

combinations.title: Make selection affect combat
combinations.explanation: Surveilling before combat both enables the flyer to attack and triggers the team power bonus.
combinations.requirements: Fateseer triggers once per turn. Without another enabler, the Phantasm activation costs four mana.
combinations.question: What should happen before you declare attackers?
combinations.answer: Scry or surveil first so the permission and power bonus are active.

combinations.title: Turn milling into a late-game board
combinations.explanation: Repeated Omit Variables casts stock the graveyard for a larger Recruitment flashback.
combinations.requirements: The flashback costs eight mana. Spend on defence too; milling alone does not stop attacks.
combinations.question: What must the rest of this deck do while you fill the graveyard?
combinations.answer: Provide early blockers and interaction so you can reach the expensive payoff.

combinations.title: Give a ping a second job
combinations.explanation: Vicious Verse deals the noncombat damage required to return Repriser from the graveyard.
combinations.requirements: Budget mana for both the spell and the return. A finality counter means the returned creature will be exiled if it would die.
combinations.question: Can this return the same Repriser after it dies with a finality counter?
combinations.answer: No. Finality replaces that death with exile.

combinations.title: Separate ramp from restricted mana
combinations.explanation: Crafter can help pay for Soul Tether or Kiora’s activated ability. The Heartwood token can help cast cards from your hand.
combinations.requirements: Crafter’s own mana cannot pay for Kiora from your hand. Kiora’s repeatable Dragon ability costs eight mana.
combinations.question: Which mana source can help cast Kiora from your hand?
combinations.answer: The Heartwood token can; Crafter’s restricted mana cannot.

combinations.title: Make lifegain replenish your hand
combinations.explanation: With both creatures present, another creature entering gains life and can trigger a Bloombrute draw.
combinations.requirements: Bloombrute draws only once each turn. A second creature that turn does not provide a second draw.
combinations.question: Do two life-gain events in one turn draw two cards?
combinations.answer: No. Bloombrute’s draw trigger is limited to once each turn.

combinations.title: Recover the creatures you trade away
combinations.explanation: Edgar can sacrifice another creature; Revival can return an eligible small creature with an extra counter.
combinations.requirements: Revival only returns creatures with mana value three or less. Count eligible targets, not just sacrifice outlets.
combinations.question: Which targets should you check when considering Revival?
combinations.answer: Creature cards with mana value three or less that can reach your graveyard.

combinations.title: Check what actually reached the graveyard
combinations.explanation: Witchstalker mills cards while potentially returning a land. A high-mana-value card in the graveyard increases Hapatra’s removal effect.
combinations.requirements: Milling four is not a guarantee of a large target for Hapatra’s calculation. Check the graveyard before committing.
combinations.question: What determines the size of Hapatra’s effect?
combinations.answer: The greatest mana value among cards in your graveyard, not their number.

combinations.title: Count loyalty before planning the payoff
combinations.explanation: Way adds seven loyalty; Kiora grants a minus-eight ability. An existing loyalty counter can bridge the gap.
combinations.requirements: A fresh seven-loyalty Jace cannot use minus eight. You also cannot activate the same planeswalker twice in one turn.
combinations.question: Does Way alone create enough loyalty for Kiora’s minus eight?
combinations.answer: No. You need at least one additional loyalty and an available loyalty activation.

combinations.title: Get two triggers from one card
combinations.explanation: Casting Vision from hand and later using flashback can each trigger Saheeli to make a hasty Thopter.
combinations.requirements: Flashback requires a discard as well as mana. Saheeli must be present when each spell is cast.
combinations.question: What extra cost must you budget for the second cast?
combinations.answer: A card to discard, in addition to the flashback mana.

combinations.title: Turn new creatures into immediate attackers
combinations.explanation: Mabel can put a counter on a creature entering this turn, allowing Gallia’s static ability to grant it haste.
combinations.requirements: Resolve the counter trigger before attacking. Gallia grants this haste to other creatures, not herself; she already has haste.
combinations.question: What links Mabel’s counters to your attack?
combinations.answer: Gallia gives your other creatures with a +1/+1 counter haste.

combinations.title: Grow while attacking in the air
combinations.explanation: The equipment’s attack trigger gains life, which grows Hortimancer before blockers are declared.
combinations.requirements: Pay the equip cost at sorcery speed. Attacking is enough to trigger lifegain; combat damage is not required.

combinations.title: A negative power can still deal damage
combinations.explanation: Tetsuko makes Loot unblockable while his power is one or less; Loot’s own ability changes how negative power assigns combat damage.
combinations.requirements: Threshold needs seven cards in your graveyard. Increasing Loot’s power can change this interaction.
